name: Diego del Carpio (Spain)
description: Vertically divided at a third from the hoist, red with three yellow crowns and white with the crowned municipal arms of Diego del Carpio (a bend on red) at the centre of the fly.
history: The flag is described as rectangular of 1:2, parted at a third from the staff, red at the hoist with three gold crowns and white at the fly with the municipal arms at its centre (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 161 of 20 August 2001).

features.role: Diego del Carpio arms — bend on red
